title: folder import browser and rename seam

commit.merge_subject: merge: folder import browser and rename seam

description:
Owner request 2026-11-15: import a whole folder's videos through
the library title row, on top of the 92615d8 data layer.

The Library title row gains a folder icon RIGHT of a new import
icon button (ScreenHeader's actions slot; the FAB stays — its
removal was not asked). The folder button launches
ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE with a persistable read grant: the tree
grant IS the permission, so no manifest change — a
SecurityException on the take is non-fatal and the browser's
enumeration reports the honest state if the grant truly is missing.

The granted tree takes over the screen with a new full-screen
browser (never a sheet): the folder's direct supported-video
children as a 3-column grid (LazyVerticalGrid; the brief's explicit
grid wins over DESIGN.md's list rule), 16dp gutters, 8dp between
cells. Already-imported files stay visible but dimmed (40% alpha +
an Imported tag, no gestures)
changed: data: video tree enumeration + clip rename seam
ui: folder import browser + header wiring
